mapper.insert: insert into site (site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time) values (#{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{regionId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{region,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sido,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sigungu,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eupmyeondong,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: update site set region_id = #{regionId,jdbcType=CHAR}, name = #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, region = #{region,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, address = #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sido = #{sido,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sigungu = #{sigungu,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, eupmyeondong = #{eupmyeondong,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where site_id = #{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.select: select site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time from site where site_id = #{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR}
select site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time from site

select s.site_id, s.region_id, s.name, s.region, s.address, s.sido, s.sigungu, s.eupmyeondong, s.contact_phone, s.create_time, count(distinct h.household_id) as total_households, count(distinct h.dong) as dong_count, count(distinct case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then h.household_id end) as completed_households from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id left join work_report wr on h.household_id = wr.household_id and wr.delete_flg = 0 and wr.status = 'COMPLETED'
and s.region_id = #{regionId}
and (s.name like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or s.address like concat('%', #{query}, '%'))
group by s.site_id
order by (case when count(distinct h.household_id) > 0 then count(distinct case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then h.household_id end) * 1.0 / count(distinct h.household_id) else 0 end) desc, s.create_time desc
order by s.create_time desc
limit #{limit}

select s.site_id, s.region_id, s.name, s.region, s.address, s.sido, s.sigungu, s.eupmyeondong, s.contact_phone, s.create_time, count(distinct h.household_id) as total_households, count(distinct h.dong) as dong_count, count(distinct case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then h.household_id end) as completed_households from ( select site_id, region_id, name, region, address, sido, sigungu, eupmyeondong, contact_phone, create_time from site
and region_id = #{regionId}
and (name like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or address like concat('%', #{query}, '%'))
order by create_time desc limit #{size} offset #{offset} ) s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id left join work_report wr on h.household_id = wr.household_id and wr.delete_flg = 0 and wr.status = 'COMPLETED' group by s.site_id order by s.create_time desc

select s.site_id, s.region_id, s.name, s.region, s.address, s.sido, s.sigungu, s.eupmyeondong, s.contact_phone, s.create_time, h.household_id as hh_id, h.site_id as hh_site_id, h.dong as hh_dong, h.ho as hh_ho, h.head_name as hh_head_name, h.target_type as hh_target_type, h.install_status as hh_install_status, h.remarks as hh_remarks, h.create_time as hh_create_time, wr.report_id as hh_report_id, wr.status as hh_report_status, wr.user_id as hh_report_user_id, wr.reporter_name as hh_reporter_name, date_format(wr.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as hh_report_time, (select count(*) from household where site_id = s.site_id) as total_households, (select count(distinct dong) from household where site_id = s.site_id) as dong_count, (select count(distinct h_sub.household_id) from household h_sub inner join work_report wr_sub on h_sub.household_id = wr_sub.household_id and wr_sub.delete_flg = 0 and wr_sub.status = 'COMPLETED' where h_sub.site_id = s.site_id) as completed_households from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id left join work_report wr on h.household_id = wr.household_id and wr.delete_flg = 0 where s.site_id = #{siteId} order by h.dong asc, cast(h.ho as unsigned) asc, h.ho asc

select count(distinct s.site_id) as totalSites, count(distinct h.household_id) as totalTarget, count(distinct case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then h.household_id end) as completedTarget from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id left join work_report wr on h.household_id = wr.household_id and wr.delete_flg = 0 and wr.status = 'COMPLETED'
and s.region_id = #{regionId}
